items.title: Keats House: Sound and Breath
items.summary: Join acclaimed Scottish poet Niall Campbell alongside Australian poet Todd Turner for an evening exploring deep immersions in landscape, memory, and the quiet intersections of our worlds. The event will also mark the UK launch of Turner’s third collection, 'Breathwork'. Image: Niall Campbell (left) and Todd Turner This event and any associated ticketing and personal data capture is managed directly by the City of London Corporation. Learn more

items.title: Nature Journaling Workshop
items.summary: Join us for a guided walk and nature journaling workshop held in the Kenwood Estate . Nature journaling is a method of recording and collecting your observations in a variety of ways - note making, sketching, writing or whatever method works best for you. Nature journaling can enrich your experience of the natural world, deepen your relationship with the local environment and help develop your identification skills. The £10 donation covers materials and our session leader’s time, but do let us know if that is unaffordable. Free for Heath Hands members and for under 18s. You can also bring your own notebooks or pens if you wish. Also, feel free to bring your phones to take photos to draw from and try out some helpful apps. We'll share how technology can be used to bolster a nature journaling practice. All welcome. You do not need to be an artist or a naturalist to enjoy this workshop! Anyone under 18 should be accompanied by a responsible adult. We will be meeting in the Kenwood area - exact meeting location will be given upon booking. Please note, this event will be held mostly outside. If the weather is bad we may have to reschedule, but we will still go ahead if there’s a bit of rain! Find out more about Shilpa’s work here. Or visit her website: shilpaagashe.com Book here

items.summary: Join us for a guided walk of Queen’s Park, celebrating the season of Autumn. We’ll be taking a look at seasonal changes, hedgerows and more. All welcome, including children of any age - but anyone under 18 should be accompanied by a responsible adult. The walk is free (donations welcome) but booking is essential. Book here

items.title: Queen’s Park Family Autumn Activities
items.summary: Join us for an afternoon of autumn-themed family fun in Queens Park. Make a leaf crown, join a scavenger hunt, and learn about the seasonal changes in the trees and hedgerows around you. We’ll be located near the cafe from 2pm onwards. All welcome, including children of any age - but anyone under 18 should be accompanied by a responsible adult. This activity is free, and no booking is required. We strongly reccomed arriving at 2pm to take advantage of all activities on offer.

items.title: Family creative walk
items.summary: Join us for a family-friendly guided creative walk. Our artist in residence, Shilpa Agashe, will lead the walk and will encourage everyone to observe flowers, plants and wildlife and draw, paint, write or take photos in response to what you see. This walk will start outside, ending inside with hot chocolate! All materials provided (though you’re welcome to bring a favourite notebook if you like!). All welcome, including children of all ages, but any children should be accompanied by a responsible adult. Booking is required (click the button below), and we’ll send joining instructions prior to the walk. The walk will meet in the Parliament Hill area - further details provided on booking. This walk is free for children, and £5 for adults. Book here

items.title: HHEC Launch and Twilight Walk
items.summary: Join us for the launch event of our new Youth programme: Hampstead Heath Eco Club . Learn about our future plans for the club: events, workshops, walks and more, then join us for a guided walk, exploring the Heath at twilight. Will you be lucky enough to hear an owl? Spot a bat? We’ll have UV torches to discover the hidden world of illuminescence, as well as our trusty bat detectors. This is a youth event is open to children age 10-17 only . Booking is required (click the button below), and we’ll send joining instructions prior to the walk. The walk will meet in the Parliament Hill area - further details provided on booking. Book here
